concerns.text: FR-003 and Edge Cases require applying log(mood_std + 0.01) specifically within the model fitting step to preserve the raw 'mood_std' for other analyses. Task T015b permanently transforms and writes this value to 'daily_aggregates.csv' during preprocessing (US1), creating a missing task for the requirement to keep the raw variance metric available for the model step as specified in FR-003.

FR-007 requires generating a PDF/HTML report. While T032 exists, it is marked incomplete. More critically, FR-004 requires the report to explicitly label findings as 'associational'. Task T033 addresses this but is also incomplete. There is no task ensuring the report generation logic (T032) actually injects the 'associational' disclaimer text required by FR-004 before the report is finalized.

Plan.md and Spec.md require schema definitions (daily_aggregates.schema.yaml, model_results.schema.yaml) and validation of results against them. Tasks T005a, T005b (schema creation) and T025 (saving/validating model results) are marked incomplete. There is no task to actually generate the 'model_results.json' artifact or validate it, leaving FR-003 (model convergence reporting) and FR-005 (LOPO reporting) without a defined output mechanism.

Constitution Principle I (Reproducibility) and Plan.md require a fully pinned environment. Task T003 (Configure linting/formatting) is incomplete. While T002 installs dependencies, the missing configuration for flake8/black (T003) means the 'Reproducibility' requirement for a standardized environment setup is not fully covered by a task.

Plan.md requires 'quickstart.md' validation to ensure documentation accuracy. Task T038 is marked incomplete. Without this task, there is no mechanism to verify that the 'quickstart.md' (a required plan element) actually works, violating the 'Reproducibility' requirement that the project must be runnable end-to-end.

Spec.md Edge Cases explicitly list handling for 'days with zero mood entries' and 'days with exactly 0 mood variability'. While T015b handles the log(0) case, there is no specific task to write unit tests for the 'zero mood entries' edge case (dropping the day entirely) or the 'single participant days' case mentioned in Edge Cases, leaving these specific acceptance scenarios unverified.
